dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Excuse me. Can I borrow these books?
dialogue.reading: ɪkˈskjuːz miː. kən aɪ ˈbɑːroʊ ðiːz ˈbʊks?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Yes. You can borrow them for two weeks. But you must return them on time.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. juː kən ˈbɑːroʊ ðɛm fər ˈtuː ˈwiːks. bʌt juː mʌst rɪˈtɜːrn ðɛm ɑːn ˈtaɪm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. Can I study here in the evening?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. kən aɪ ˈstʌdi ˈhɪr ɪn ði ˈiːvnɪŋ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No, you must not eat in the library. Look at the rules.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, juː mʌst ˈnɑːt ˈiːt ɪn ðə ˈlaɪbrɛri. ˈlʊk ət ðə ˈruːlz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh, I see. No food and no noise.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, aɪ ˈsiː. ˈnoʊ ˈfuːd ənd ˈnoʊ ˈnɔɪz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's right. You must not make noise. People are studying.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈraɪt. juː mʌst ˈnɑːt ˈmeɪk ˈnɔɪz. ˈpiːpəl ər ˈstʌdiɪŋ.
